research_question: On the same exposed development queries, what is the query-macro NDCG@10 difference of fixed exact Jaccard session-kNN K1 versus frozen C1?
interpretation: Whole fixed method comparison: session-neighbor selection, normalization and self-item voting change together; not a one-factor attribution, temporal generalization claim or final model choice.

model.train_set: T_s = distinct items in every eligible train basket of s; include unlabelled baskets and singleton sets; keep only train-window part of crossing sessions, never filter by eventual length/end or label availability.
model.index: Exact item-to-train-session inverted index and full distinct T_s; no sampled sessions, recent-session cap, pruning or ANN.
model.support_check: Number of distinct indexed sessions per item must exactly equal frozen C1 S_i; T_s must match C1 train session lineage.
model.history: H(q) = distinct same-session items through query_ms/basket_index inclusive, including current basket and eligible cross-role past context; identical to frozen C1 history.
model.unknown_seeds: Retain all unknown items in H and in Jaccard union denominator; they contribute no train overlaps. Do not drop unknown seeds or the query.
model.neighbor_eligibility: All train sessions with positive overlap with H, excluding exact current (visitorid,session_start_ms). Other train sessions of the same visitor remain eligible.
model.arithmetic: Exact integer numerator/denominator and rational comparisons/sums; no epsilon ties or binary64 ordering.
model.neighbor_boundary: Take first min(500,positive eligible session count); do not expand ties. k is a fixed method parameter, not permission to truncate the search pool.
model.score: score(j,q) = sum(sim(H,T_s) * indicator(j in T_s) for s in selected neighbors); one vote per item per selected session, no score normalization or P0 blend.
model.unsupported_target: Absent from all train sets implies zero K1 evidence, not removal from candidate or denominator; P0 tie/fill remains.

ranking.candidate_rule: All items with first_view_ms < query_ms from accepted causal catalog; keep seen, cold and zero-vote items.
ranking.fallback: If no positive causal scores, exactly original P0 order; if fewer than 10 positive items, fill from entire zero-score complement. No truncated P0-top10 shortcut.
ranking.short_catalog: Return min(10,candidate_count); empty nonempty-target query scores zero; broken/missing history join stops.

fixed_validation.interpretation: copied from accepted P0/data receipts; C1 item-support keys must equal P0 positive keys, so these historical support partitions remain identical

evaluation.roster: All 166897 original validation keys and stored order; equality across K1/C1/P0/D1. Missing/extra/duplicate stops; no inner-join exclusions.
evaluation.metrics: Unchanged full-target P0 v1 NDCG/Recall/HitRate/MRR, visitor-macro NDCG and common-candidate-union coverage; unreachable target items remain in Recall and IDCG denominators.
evaluation.descriptive: K1-P0, K1-D1 and secondary metrics/slices only; no new old-control pairwise intervals.
evaluation.conditional: Same 161211 all-target-reachable queries reported separately; never substitute for main.
evaluation.exposure: P0/C1/D1 validation scores, slices and intervals already known before K1 selection. K1 score uncomputed; interval is conditional development evidence, not untouched test.
evaluation.nonfinite: forbidden; undefined groups null with reason

uncertainty.reference_value: Round-trip binary64 C1 NDCG from accepted C1 query JSONL; copy original P0 values for descriptive K1-P0
uncertainty.reduction: Per-query K1 binary64 minus copied C1 binary64; main math.fsum in accepted query order. Per-visitor d_v=math.fsum in within-visitor query order; each replicate math.fsum(w_v*d_v in numeric visitor order)/sum(w_v*n_v) with exact integer denominator. Do not average visitor means.
uncertainty.audit_reuse: Verify each draw SHA (little-endian signed int64), RNG before/after and sampled query denominator against accepted C1 bootstrap; compute NEW K1-C1 deltas and interval in K1 namespace only. Never copy C1-P0 deltas/interval as K1 results.
uncertainty.multiple_comparison_policy: One prespecified primary contrast only. No simultaneous two-control superiority claim or new family-wise inference. All secondary differences descriptive.
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional exposed-development resampling only; report unfavorable or cross-zero interval unchanged, no automatic model selection/test unlock.

slices_and_diagnostics.inherited: All original visitor seen/new, train activity, current/target basket cardinality, and target support all-positive/mixed/all-zero slices; shared C1 S_i definition, never K1 neighbor keys.
slices_and_diagnostics.low_support: Keep current multiple 56, target multiple 53 and mixed 3 as descriptive; do not merge/drop to improve results.
K1: H cardinality and unknown seed count
selected neighbor count and boundary ties
positive causal score count and zero-fill count
full fallback with mutually exclusive reason: no_supported_seed / only_self_session_overlap / no_eligible_positive_neighbor / no_positive_causal_vote
cross-tabs with C1/D1 fallback and cold targets
slices_and_diagnostics.known_cold: Historical all-zero target slice 11943 queries / 5769 visitors; old three-arm ranking metrics zero. K1 result unknown; not claimed to solve cold items.

resources.scope: Future one train index build + full validation + primary bootstrap + full independent oracle; cooperative checkpoints, not instantaneous OS enforcement.
resources.train_only_preflight: Next phase only: scan role metadata, decode train basket items only; measure sessions, distinct memberships M=sum_s|T_s|=sum_i S_i, singleton count, max session size and max posting size. May use temporary per-session sets; no global K1 index or validation/test items/targets.
resources.structural_cost: For a query, raw posting visits <= sum_(i in H) S_i before self exclusion/dedup; voting <= sum_(s in N500)|T_s|. Train-only totals cannot guarantee query runtime or RSS. Exact overlaps must be fully considered.
resources.on_exceed: Stop and preserve started/failure/partial evidence; no retry, sampling, history clipping, smaller k or denominator change under v1.

planned_acceptance: Hand-calculated exact Jaccard/voting and brute-force independent synthetic reference before real use
Repeated items, simultaneous baskets, singleton self-votes, same-session exclusion versus same-visitor other-session inclusion, train cutoff and no future injection
Unknown H items in union denominator; zero overlaps; 499/500/501 positive neighbors; exact equal-similarity and kth-boundary ties
Full causal candidate enumeration, self-item recommendations, strict first_view equality, P0 missing-count independence, complete zero-score fill and short/empty catalogs
Independent SQL DISTINCT(session,item) reconstructs ALL train memberships and inverted postings; compare C1 support and complete lineage
Independent full eligible-neighbor set, exact similarity/order/top500 and full candidate-score/zero-complement ranking for EVERY validation query; no sampled oracle
Full four-arm keys/order/denominators and nested output readback; independent Fraction/Decimal metrics; all 2000 bootstrap draws and reductions
Tampered provenance, missing/duplicate queries, changed limits, future timestamp injection and test/final CLI rejection
Only after synthetic acceptance and train-only cost audit: freeze implementation/environment/oracle/output schema/checkpoints and separate guarded validation entry; not executed here

reserved_test.rule: Existing P0/C1/D1 gates grant no K1 permission. Final selection, train+validation refit and at most one logical retrospective test are separate future specifications/acceptance/execution scope; this freeze does not authorize them.

change_control: Any change to source/window/k/similarity/self vote/history/neighbor pool/ties/metrics/inference/budgets needs a new version before scoring. Keep v1 and all old evidence bytes; report negative/cross-zero results. No final-choice rule or tuned alternate K1 in this round.
limitations: Anonymous visitors are not proven independent people
No fresh-time generalization or operational ingestion/revision/completeness evidence
No purchase/revenue/causal or commercial deployment conclusion
Historical Olist 25 and UCI 87/83 group limits remain; daily delay alert budget 10%; Dashboard deferred
